title: Error messages leak internals and secrets
summary: A customer-lookup tool returns its raw failure to the client: a stack trace, source paths and the database connection string with its password. The secure twin returns a generic error and logs details server-side.
credits: Pattern also exercised by MCPGoat (MIT) and the Appsecco vulnerable MCP servers lab (MIT); re-implemented, no code copied.
